text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a micro-blue swap tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Goal: validate router-b route handling for large payloads. Weight plan: 5% / 25% / 70% with 8m probes. Keep 20m rollback window.
jon: ok. what are we pinning and which image?
maria: pinning service:v3.0.0 and router config `rtr-microblue-2026-03`. Notes in the ticket.
lee: add probe for 95th latency, mem. Also watch payload-size errors and 413s.
maria: will add probes: p95_latency, memory_rss, payload_rejects.
deploy-bot: deploy prepared: micro-blue-swap by @maria. Steps: prewarm, apply config, gradual weights, post-validate, finalize.
monitor-bot: maintenance window logged: 2026-03-23T03:30:00Z -> 2026-03-23T04:00:00Z
jon: rollback policy? auto or manual?
lee: auto-fallback if p95 >25% over baseline OR 413 rate >0.5% for 3m OR error_rate >2% for 5m. Manual abort allowed by release-approvers.
maria: adding those thresholds to the deploy description. Also we'll set session affinity TTL to 2m for the swap to reduce long sticks.
jon: approvals? need two approvers for config changes in this window.
lee: I can approve.
jon: approved.
deploy-bot: approval threshold met. Scheduling at 2026-03-23T03:30:00Z.
maria: prewarm step: populate router-b cache with hot keys for 10m before shift.
lee: good idea. helps avoid mem pressure spikes.
deploy-bot: scheduled start triggered: prewarm started.
monitor-bot: prewarm metrics: cache_fill 92% after 6m.
maria: prewarm done. applying config now.
deploy-bot: applied config rtr-microblue-2026-03. shifting 5% to router-b.
maria: step1 probes ok. holding 8m.
monitor-bot: p95 1.04x baseline, payload_reject 0.0%, mem stable.
jon: go to 25% when you see stable traces.
maria: moving to 25% now. debug logging enabled for router-b for 12m.
lee: seeing a small increase in TLS handshakes at t+2m, but nothing sustained.
maria: holding. moving to 70% in 10m if stable.
deply-bot: (typo) -- ignore
maria: moving to 70% now. probes running.
monitor-bot: p95 back to baseline, error_rate 0.4%. All green.
jon: nice. confirm finalize steps and release note?
maria: finalizing. release note: "Micro-blue swap: validate router-b for large payloads. Pinned service:v3.0.0. Auto-fallback and manual abort described."
lee: documented. adding prewarm task permanently for next swaps.
deply-bot: (typo) abort test not needed
maria: marking rollout complete. will update ticket and close window. thanks team.
jon: great run. keep an eye on payload_rejects for next 24h.
lee: acknowledged. leaving a short follow-up item: add synthetic with large payloads in the smoke suite.
maria: adding to backlog. closing thread. :rocket:
